mean_cn: n.部落；（兴趣相同的）一批（人，一伙（多含贬义））；群，族
mean_en: (in developing countries) a group of people of the same race, and with the same customs, language, religion, etc., living in a particular area and often led by a chief; a large number of people
sentence: The primitive tribe people make the fire with wood.
sentence_trans: 原始部落的人用木柴生火。
